description: This file defines a React context provider component for managing application-wide state related to doctors, user profile, and authentication token. It includes API calls to fetch doctor list and user profile data, and provides these via React Context.

methods.name: AppContextProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides application state and functions via context.

methods.name: getDoctosData
methods.description: Fetches list of doctors from API and updates state.

methods.name: loadUserProfileData
methods.description: Fetches user profile data from API and updates state.
